title: Simultaneous move semantics
description: Some games have simultaneous action selection (Rock-Paper-Scissors, Diplomacy negotiation phases). The schema needs to express 'both players submit secretly, then reveal.' This is a server-authority operation that the visibility model handles, but the turn structure needs to express it. How does this interact with the three-tier architecture? Is this a built-in turn type or a pattern composed from existing primitives?
close_reason: Option B: compose from existing primitives. Phase simultaneous:true + visibility model + server gate. No new turn_order type needed.
